name: Captain Koth
description: Captain Koth is a stern guard in the deep blue and silver livery of the Rosnar family, tasked with securing the imposing gates of House Rosnar in the Sea Ward[cite: 1]. Unimpressed by self-proclaimed deputies or invocations of Force Grey authority, he stands as a firm and bureaucratic wall, maintaining strict privacy for the noble estate[cite: 1].
ideals: Duty: 'The privacy and security of House Rosnar are absolute; no one enters without proper authorization[cite: 1].'
Order: 'Titles, badges, and threats mean nothing without a warrant from the Blackstaff[cite: 1].'
bonds: House Rosnar and the enforcement of security across their Sea Ward estate[cite: 1].
The chain of command governing noble house defense in Waterdeep.
flaws: Strictly bound by protocol, making him unyielding and difficult to sway through charm or intimidation[cite: 1].
speech_patterns: Cool, formal, and authoritative, delivering dismissals with polite finality[cite: 1].
mannerisms: Stands rigidly at post, blocks unauthorized entryways, and assesses visitors with a skeptical and evaluating eye[cite: 1].
motivations: To enforce the security and privacy of House Rosnar against unverified outsiders, mercenaries, and nosy adventurers[cite: 1].
knowledge: Estate defense protocols and security arrangements for House Rosnar[cite: 1].
Familiarity with municipal authorities, noble household laws, and warrant requirements in the Sea Ward[cite: 1].
gm_notes: Captain Koth functions as a physical and social barrier guarding House Rosnar[cite: 1]. He can be used to block the party from casually trespassing on noble estates, forcing them to find alternative, stealthier infiltration methods (like scaling walls) or secure official legal warrants[cite: 1].
